en.headline: Targeted treatment and prevention can curb child obesity
en.hook: Simple steps could stop obesity early for teens
en.what: Experts say focused treatment and preventive actions can address childhood obesity. Two specific measures are suggested for young people.
en.why: Knowing these steps helps teens and families act early to stay healthy.
